name: Hot-pan dinner
intro: One very hot pan: sear the protein, then char corn and peaches in what's left. Ten minutes, and the pan does the cooking.

proteins.name: Skirt steak
proteins.timing: Seared first, 2–3 minutes a side, then rested while the corn and peaches char.

needs: 2 ears of corn, kernels cut off

steps.text: Heat a cast-iron or heavy skillet until it smokes.
Salt your protein and sear it with a little oil — don't move it. Steak: 2–3 minutes a side. Shrimp: 1–2. Move it to a plate; steak rests.
Peach halves into the same pan, cut side down, until they char.
Corn kernels in next, until they blacken in spots. Salt them.
Everything on one plate, with the juices from the resting meat. Slice the steak across the grain.
Your flavor, basil torn over, flaky salt.

leftovers: Leftover steak or shrimp is tomorrow's tacos or rice bowl.
